name: Thijarian Witness
oracle_text:
Flash
Bear Witness — Whenever another creature dies, if it was attacking or blocking alone, exile it and investigate. (Create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
blocked_sentences: Bear Witness — Whenever another creature dies, if it was attacking or blocking alone, exile it and investigate.

needs.what: a last-known-information combat check on a dies trigger's subject: the creature was an attacking creature and the only attacking creature, or a blocking creature and the only blocking creature, at the moment it left the battlefield (usable as a creature_dies trigger filter key or intervening-if condition)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys carry no attacking/blocking key and filters are read against the card in the graveyard, where it is no longer in combat; the 'attacks alone' templates use a cmp on attackers at declaration time, and value_keys like attackers_this_turn / opponents_attacked_this_combat count declarations, not who was still attacking or blocking alone when the subject died; snapshot only captures values from targets, not the dying creature's combat status
